newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PanGlobal to raise stake in Econstates.
newsitem.headline: PanGlobal to raise stake in Econstates.

text.p: Malaysia's PanGlobal Bhd said on Tuesday it has proposed to acquire a 26.7 percent stake in Econstates Bhd for 240 million ringgit in cash.
The proposed acquisition, to be financed by bank borrowings and internally generated funds, will increase PanGlobal's equity interest in Econstates to 30.6 percent.
PanGlobal said in a statement that the acquisition would enable the company to venture further into the property sector as well as allow any future restructuring within the group.
Shares of PanGlobal and Econstates were suspended on Tuesday for the announcement.
